opening.argument: The video directs viewers into a paid package-based network where each signup is automatically placed in the recruiter’s downline. It tells participants to choose a package and proceed through a banking transaction, while the payment screen presents a 3000 EUR package with bank-wire payment. The tutorial also explains placing recruits on the left or right side of a network tree, and the accompanying dashboard displays bonuses, points, sponsored members, leadership rank, and total bonus. Taken together, these are not merely neutral registration steps: they establish a recruitment-dependent earning structure in which participation, package payment, and the placement of new members are central to the presented process.
